# 24

Our Business

Empowering progress with a differentiated portfolio

As one of the leading manufacturers of Generic APIs, we offer an integrated ecosystem to our global clients. We operate state-of-the-art cGMP-compliant manufacturing facilities with deep-rooted expertise in synthetic chemistry and process development. This has positioned us at the forefront of Generic API development and manufacturing.

Generic Drug

Since our inception, manufacturing Generic Drug Substances

Substance (GDS)

has been the mainstay of our operations and core business.

Today, on the strength of our top-notch product quality, expertise in niche chemistry and on-time delivery, we have established ourselves as one of the most reliable global API suppliers.

Under this business division, we develop and manufacture Prime APIs (which involve large volumes of mature molecules) and Specialty APIs (comprising lower volumes of complex molecules with less competition).
